rule: Exact normalised full-name tokens and same nationality against the master (contemporary editions only; the deduplicated representative wins). Reviewed alias or override rows carry a note. Homonyms are never merged (Gabriel Martinelli vs Matheus Martinelli, the Atalanta Éderson vs Ederson Moraes, Pepê, André). Missing people are never invented; ranks 1-50 were imported, the remainder is documented.
